discovery: Cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed that a brief period of exponential expansion in the early universe would explain why the universe is flat, homogeneous and free of magnetic monopoles. Linde developed new and chaotic inflation and turned the idea into a workable, predictive framework. Mukhanov, with Chibisov, showed that quantum fluctuations during inflation seed all cosmic structure. He predicted a nearly scale-invariant spectrum of adiabatic, nearly Gaussian perturbations with a slight red tilt. COBE, WMAP, Planck and ground-based CMB experiments have since confirmed these predictions. The spectral index is now measured at about 0.965, clearly below one, as inflation predicted. This is bold theory connecting particle physics to the largest observable scales, and decades of precision data have tested it and borne it out. It changed how specialists and the public understand the origin of galaxies and of space itself.
